snippet.title: Sonic 2: Gear Shift ~ Demo 2 Trailer
snippet.description:
TAKE IT 2 THE MAX with "Sonic the Hedgehog 2: Gear Shift"! The diabolical Dr. "Ivo" Robotnik is up to no good again, and has captured Sonic's new best friend, Miles "Tails" Prower! Ride on a minecart through danger, cross hazardous heights... all in this complete re-imagining of Sonic the Hedgehog 2 for the Sega Master System and Game Gear - now with 16-bit Sega Genesis/Mega Drive graphics! Can you save your two-tailed friend and foil Robotnik's plans once more?

This upcoming demo is available at CGS2025 and can be found through the following link here!
https://hedgehogtechnicalinstitute.com/forum/viewtopic.php?t=199&sid=8cccd7a0c6b0be23a4459251545385dd

GAMEJOLT PAGE
https://gamejolt.com/games/sonic2smsgs/943118
